blocks.content: Normalization of marks is mandatorily applied for multi-shift examinations to ensure equity across candidate batches.

items: Always remember: 1/3rd mark deduction applies for every wrong response in CBT stages.
Minimum qualifying percentage: UR/EWS - 40%, OBC - 30%, SC - 30%, ST - 25%.
Shortlisting for CBT-2 is strictly based on normalized marks obtained in CBT-1.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: RRB competitive recruitment consists of Computer Based Tests (CBT-1 and CBT-2) for selection across technical and non-technical cadres.
A negative marking penalty of 1/3rd mark is applied for every incorrect answer in objective CBTs.
Normalization of marks is mandatorily applied for multi-shift examinations to ensure equity.
Core subjects tested include General Awareness, Mathematics, General Intelligence & Reasoning, and General Science.
